comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 83746f7, the head of main. Four commits carry the installed 2.2.0; the installed plugin.json is byte-identical to the one in e90eda5 and 83746f7 and differs from the two earlier ones, and those two later commits have identical source, so either is the build. It is not one of the earlier pair: the shipped build carries the isfinite guard on the scaled output that e90eda5 added. All twenty-six controls and jacks have widgets. Every input is read with a plain getVoltage and every output written with a plain setVoltage, so nothing here is polyphonic. The Oil Slick filter is bypassed rather than merely wide open below 0.001 on the knob, and the Choke Point drive the same, so those two knobs have a hard step at the counter-clockwise stop. The panel lettering is drawn from C++ rather than from the SVG, because the maker notes NanoSVG drops text elements; the CV jack labels open, jckt, lock, emgo, slck, chok, tilt and tnk are drawn behind their jacks and are mostly covered by them.
